Name: Stardew Multibyte Languages Input
Author: NikunoTa
Description:
[size=3][b]I created this for the growing number of mods that allow you to communicate with NPCs via chat using AI.[/b][/size]

[b]Examples
[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42597]The Living Valley[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36338]Social Valley[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43475]AliveNpcs[/url]﻿
[/list]etc...

[b]Important notes before use[/b]
[list]
[*]Windows only
[*][b]Requirement:[/b] .NET 8.0 Desktop Runtime
[*]Does not work in full-screen mode
[*]SMAPI must be installed (solely for detecting the game window)
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Launch StardewValley and this file
[*]Set StardewValley to a state where text input is required(Name input,Chat screen,etc...)

[*]Enter text into the input field in this file and press Enter
[*]As it will be reflected in StardewValley, simply press Enter there
[/list]Using Alt+Tab or similar should allow for more efficient input.

[b]Other[/b]
If you encounter any issues, please contact me via a post in the thread.
The source code is available on [url=https://github.com/nikunota-jpn/StardewMultibyteLanguagesInput]GitHub[/url].

[b]Other Mods[/b]
I am currently working on a Japanese localisation for TLV  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43456]The Living Valley - Japanese Translation[/url]

例

[b]使用前の注意[/b]
[list]
[*]Windows専用
[*].NET 8.0 Desktop Runtime が必要です
[*]フルスクリーンでは動作しない
[*]SMAPIを導入している必要がある（ゲームウィンドウの判定のためだけに）
[/list]
[b]使い方[/b]
[list]
[*]StardewValleyと、本ファイルを起動
[*]StardewValleyでテキスト入力が必要な状態にする(名前入力,チャット画面,など・・・)
[*]本ファイルの入力欄にテキストを入れ、エンター
[*]StardewValleyに反映されるので、そのままエンター
[/list]Alt+Tabなどを利用すれば、より手間を少なく入力できるはずです。
